demonstration.summary: Red comets open into delicate silver points that blossom into clusters of golden sparks. A steady sequence builds to three closely spaced bursts.
demonstration.note: Official Brothers BP2377, 200g, 16 shots visible on packaging and overlay. One unit; no obvious cut within performance. One-second decoded sampling throughout 6–53 seconds; final launches/apertures additionally sampled every 0.267 seconds. Thirteen spaced bursts followed by three close launches around 48.3–48.9 seconds and openings around 49.6–50.1. Final fade visible by 52–53 seconds before the logo outro. Golden branching follows the first pale points; no extra finale generated.

demonstration.summary: Green pearls rise through a golden spray, followed by fuller showers of gold, bright white points and branching sparks.
demonstration.note: Official Brothers BP4247 and matching round gold shell-shaped package; one stationary unit. Five-second sampling from intro through 130 seconds. No obvious cuts or simultaneous second product inside the performance; exposure and smoke vary. Early green stars over a narrow gold jet; broader fine gold by about 23s; bright white around 43s; alternating fine gold and larger flowers later. Still emitting at 130 seconds near the end of the 132-second recording. Closure is simulated, not an observed product finish.

demonstration.summary: Golden branches open into bright white points, leaving a short trail of fine glitter.
demonstration.note: Official BP2690, 12 ball shells, 1-3/4 inch on title/overlay. Packaging verified at 3.4 seconds. Intro graphic through 5 seconds excluded. First real burst begins approximately 5.45; open at 5.6 and 6.2, sparse by 6.8, dark by 7.4. One sample; no claim about other eleven shells. No cut inside this burst; edits between separate shell demonstrations are excluded.

name: The Red, White and Blue Salute

demonstration.summary: Angled sprays spread into a broad fan of silver and gold, with red and green pearls and branching clusters of sparks. The fan narrows into a brighter central spray.
demonstration.note: Official Brothers BP4252 and fan-shaped blue package. Multiple angled jets belong to one unit, not multiple products. Five-second sampling of the actual video from 5–105 seconds. Camera framing changes but no obvious sequence cut in the selected performance. Right-hand ignition, then three angled sprays by approximately 13s. Broad intermittent flowers and colored pearls; lower fan by about 88s, brighter central activity near 103–105s. Recording ends during the late central activity. No full runtime or final product shutdown claimed.
